column1: # title: HDMI splitter (0x58) initialisation, power-on to idle (no input needed)
# evidence: T1/S01 t=187.7-286.7 (all 641 transfers, order and values); T3/S20 t=188.1-281 (625 transfers) identical
#           except the conditional rows; T4/S40 pub 573.7-666.4: same transfer directions and order (I2C records lost,
#           aligned through the interrupt status; the timer rows ran in all four port power-downs); S for masks
# chapter: hdmi-splitter.md section 3.2 (phases A-L); rclk algorithm 3.3; calibration wait 3.4; end state 3.5
# columns: n op dev bank reg mask value note
# ops: W write value; M read-modify-write: new = (old & ~mask) | (value & mask); R read (value = traced, informative);
#      D delay in ms (value); X step described in the chapter (note names it); P poll (reg & mask) == value
# dev: 8-bit I2C address. bank: register bank for banked devices (0x58: 0-1, 0x70: 0-3), '-' unbanked,
#      '*' = the device's bank register 0x0f itself. Rows list every bank select explicitly.
# value: hex, or {expr} computed from variables defined in the chapter (base = OTP calibration-record word address,
#        rclk = reference clock in kHz, rclk10 = rclk * 10);
# note: 'cond:' = row is conditional; 'RD: RMW mask ff' = RD reads first, a plain write is equivalent
